name: js-json-pointer
instruction: Implement jsonPointer.js (CommonJS): module.exports = get. get(doc, pointer) resolves an RFC6901 JSON Pointer. The empty string returns the whole document. Otherwise the pointer MUST start with '/' or an Error is thrown. Each reference token is unescaped with '~1' -> '/' and '~0' -> '~', IN THAT ORDER. Tokens index objects by key and arrays by a decimal index with no leading zeros. Return undefined (do not throw) when a key is absent, an array index is out of range or not a valid index, or an intermediate value is not an object. A key that exists but holds undefined, null, 0 or '' must be returned as-is rather than treated as missing.
